newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Statoil adds acreage in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Statoil adds acreage in Australia.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it has gained a 25 percent stake in Australian block 95-18, 400 km northwest of Darwin.
Operator Mobil Corp and Royal Dutch/Shell also hold 25 percent each, the remining partners being Hardy Oil & Gas Plc with 13 percent and Mitsubishi with 12 percent.
The consortium will be based in Darwin and hopes to find gas reserves that could form the basis for a plant to produce liquefied natural gas, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The block lies in an area designated as Zone of Cooperation by the Australian and Indonesian authorities. The venture includes sharing revenues from operations in the area.
